business_problem: improve performance and cost for capital-markets analytics and compliance products that process massive transaction volumes for global financial institutions.
solution_summary: FIS uses Snowflake and Snowpark on Snowflake to improve performance and cost for capital-markets analytics and compliance products that process massive transaction volumes for global financial institutions. Capital-markets and compliance data from FIS products are consolidated in Snowflake for performance-sensitive analytics. Snowpark lets FIS run the heavy transformation and compute logic for its Compliance Suite directly against Snowflake data instead of relying on slower, costlier patterns. The modernized platform improves portfolio and compliance products used by banks, private equity firms, insurers, and other financial customers that depend on fast execution. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and downstream access on one governed platform reduces data copying, simplifies operations, and gives teams a single trusted operating view for analytics and AI.
